pr_title: Lean Visualizer C# toolbox project and Python Wrapper working
pr_body:
<!--- Provide a general summary of your changes in the Title above -->

#### Description
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
This PR adds a Visualizer to the ToolBox, the main functions is reading Leans zipped data files for a quick review of data quality and completion.

The new folder contains a new C# class and is in turn a Python Module. The C# side read the data and transform it into a `pandas.DataFrame`, the Python parts takes that data, plots it and saves. Also the Python module contains the CLI.

#### Related Issue
<!--- This project only accepts pull requests related to open issues -->
<!--- If suggesting a new feature or change, please discuss it in an issue first -->
<!--- If fixing a bug, there should be an issue describing it with steps to reproduce -->
<!--- Please link to the issue here: -->
Closes #1835 

#### Motivation and Context
<!--- Why is this change required? What problem does it solve? -->
There is no a fast way to parse the zipped data show the results. This kind of tools speeds up the data cleaning and maintenance.

#### Requires Documentation Change
<!--- Please indicate if these changes will require updates to documentation, and if so, specify what changes are required -->
It will not required modification to the existent documentation, on the other hand, the code is documented.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
<!--- Please describe in detail how you tested your changes. -->
<!--- Include details of your testing environment, and the tests you ran to -->
<!--- see how your change affects other areas of the code, etc. -->
All the new features in the `LeanDataReader` and the `PandasConverter` are covered by new tests.
All existing test passed.

review_comments: should tick type resolution be added to `TryParsePath` ? -- we don't need to make this change now, but it's food for thought. Reasonably the tick type is part of the path, so we could add another `out` parameter w/ the tick type, defaulting to the common tick type if not present in the file name.
no change required, but try to avoid spurious white space changes --  think most of the code follows the previous alignment and not aligning based on parentheses.
no change required -- it's nice to use the `TestCaseData` class because then you can use `SetName` to give the test case a human readable name in the test window
